name: Participating Media Regularization (Prediction Function)
definition: A prediction function that extrapolates radiance from a source albedo (α_s) to a target albedo (α_t) using the rendered source radiance (R_s) and gradient (G_s), designed to handle complex non-linear albedo behavior better than linear or log-linear models.
summary: Participating Media Regularization is a two-exponential prediction function that estimates target radiance from source data, outperforming linear models by adapting to complex albedo changes and varying mean free paths.
